description: ContextWorld Development training study. Each row is one task/model/recipe/data-scale configuration; replicates contain all available matched training runs. Tables and CSV report per-metric means and sample standard deviations. Top-level row scores and checkpoint fields retain the original source anchor; use statistics for aggregated results.
evidence_note: Per-training-run scores, checkpoint/result hashes and aggregate statistics are published. Raw per-query outputs and checkpoint downloads are not fully distributed.

field_definitions.id: task/model/regime, with optional /scale_2k or /scale_8k for smaller-data comparisons.
field_definitions.regime: original (published original weights) | scratch | joint (stage-2 joint) | frozen (stage-2 frozen encoder) | projected (legacy DINO projected init)
field_definitions.measurement_status: available = ICL Development scores exist; not_measured = absent
field_definitions.training_seed: Training seed of the source anchor retained for provenance; all matched training seeds are listed under replicates. Tables aggregate replicates.
field_definitions.training_epochs: trainer max epochs when known from the training run (10)
field_definitions.training_history_length: history length in the training dataset contract
field_definitions.evaluation_history_tokens: history tokens used by the evaluation adapter
field_definitions.input_protocol: adapter protocol (action dim, blocks, history tokens); no file paths
field_definitions.frozen_encoder_semantics: Encoder freezing policy, either explicitly selected or native to the DINO model.
field_definitions.checkpoint_sha256: Evaluated checkpoint SHA256 of the source anchor; every replicate retains its own checkpoint hash.
field_definitions.init_weights_sha256: SHA256 of warmstart initialization weights (stage-2 rows)
field_definitions.result_sha256: ICL result hash of the source anchor; every replicate retains its own result hash.
field_definitions.cem_reference_scope: scope of the CEM reference (original-environment vs per-task)
field_definitions.cem_per_seed: per-eval-seed CEM success rates with per-seed episode budget
field_definitions.speed_tracks: speed-task track breakdown (never pooled across tracks or horizons)
field_definitions.training_data_version: Named Training bundle used by the reported run; null if no bundle identity exists.
field_definitions.cem_evaluation_count: Number of original-environment planning evaluations; historical reference protocol may differ.
field_definitions.comparison_variant: Optional smaller training-data scale for a matched-regime comparison; null denotes the main study configuration.
field_definitions.training_pair_count: Number of synthetic Training pairs for the six paired tasks, not the number of independent source episodes; null for original-only, unreported or other tasks.
field_definitions.scores: Unrounded scores of the original source anchor; not a cross-training-seed aggregate. See statistics and replicates.
field_definitions.replicates: All available matched training runs for this exact task, dataset scale, regime and input protocol; scores in percent except gain/alignment/nre. CEM evaluation seeds remain nested within a training run.
field_definitions.statistics: Per-metric mean, sample standard deviation (ddof=1; null with fewer than two values), and count across training replicates. Speed tracks are aggregated separately.
field_definitions.source_matrix_sha256: Hash of the initial source study matrix; the additional frozen replicate sources below supersede its overlapping source-anchor evaluations with the complete fixed Development selections.

metric_definitions.units: percent (0-100) for main, worst, history, switch, joint, calibrated, cem; dimensionless ratios for gain, alignment, nre
metric_definitions.main: task main metric; definition differs by task: action_delay=physical_group_macro_accuracy, door=same_history_two_target_accuracy, speed=reference_speed_balanced_strict_query_win_rate_vs_every_other, others=correct_future_rate
metric_definitions.worst: Minimum score across the task-defined hidden conditions, physical response groups (Delay), or reference speeds (Speed).
metric_definitions.history: Rate at which the matching history predicts the correct target better than the competing history/history conditions, according to the task scoring rule.
metric_definitions.switch: Rate at which swapping history changes the predicted target choice under the task definition; switching alone does not establish correct direction or sufficient amplitude.
metric_definitions.joint: For the six paired tasks: both conditions choose the correct future and use the correct history, and the pair has normalized response error <1; not defined for Delay, Door and Speed.
metric_definitions.gain: Task-protocol response projection gain. The shared paired kernel sums cross energy and target energy before taking their ratio, not the arithmetic mean of per-pair ratios. Ideal 1; zero means no component along the true conditional response.
metric_definitions.alignment: Task-protocol response alignment. The shared paired kernel takes cosine similarity after concatenating pairs. Ideal 1.
metric_definitions.nre: Task-protocol normalized squared response error. The shared paired kernel divides summed squared response error by summed squared target response, not the arithmetic mean of per-pair ratios. Ideal 0; zero history response has error 1.
metric_definitions.calibrated: Fraction of pairs with NRE<1, in percent; displayed as better-than-zero response rate. Does not imply accurate response amplitude. Existing source field retained.
metric_definitions.cem: Original-environment planning success percentage. Current runs use 6 eval seeds x50; historical original references may use 3x100 or aggregate-only 300 episodes. See per-row budgets.
metric_definitions.response: Derived display score: 100*(1-nre), without clipping; NRE is already a squared error ratio. Units are points, not a success percentage. Computed from stored NRE in the renderer/CSV; source scores and evaluator outputs are unchanged. Mean=100*(1-mean_NRE), sample SD=100*SD_NRE, count=count_NRE; missing remains missing.

evaluation_split: ICL scores use Development; CEM separately evaluates original-environment planning.
notes: CEM measures original-environment planning for every row, not planning under the task hidden conditions. Current evaluations use 6 seeds x50; some original LeWM/PLDM references use historical 3x100 or aggregate-only 300-episode evidence.
DINO-WM original rows are newly retrained pixels+action original models (frozen DINO encoder) with native-input original-environment CEM; action_delay lacks H7 ICL.
Do not read DINO legacy projected rows as pixels+action original-weight warmstart results.

Means use all available matched training replicates, without selecting a preferred training seed. Smaller and expanded datasets, projected and full initialization, and Development and Test remain separate.
ICL and CEM are aggregated independently across training runs. The six CEM evaluation seeds are not six independent model trainings.
The main overview uses current task datasets. Historical data scales and projected initialization are reported separately.
